settings.title: What visitors ask about hotels & lodges

tabs.tab_title: Is it better to stay inside Zion or in Springdale?
tabs.tab_content: Zion Lodge places you in the canyon; Springdale offers more dining and lodging choices. Your transportation priorities determine the better fit.

tabs.tab_title: Can I drive from a Springdale hotel into Zion Canyon?
tabs.tab_content: Personal vehicle restrictions apply to the Scenic Drive during shuttle season. Check current NPS shuttle rules.

tabs.tab_title: Do hotel listings show real availability?
tabs.tab_content: No. This preview does not connect to a hotel inventory or booking engine.

tabs.tab_title: How far are hotels from trails?
tabs.tab_content: Different trailheads are reached through different entrances and transit stops. Measure actual routes rather than relying on a town-name distance.
